Title: Linked Resource Manager template support available for CI/CD in your data factories

Body.Content:
Azure Data Factory now generates linked Azure Resource Manager templates for continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) by breaking the factory payload into several files to help users with Resource Manager template limits.

For more information, see the documentation.
